description: Maps person.role_class to what each workflow should lead with. Keeps the harness role-aware without hardcoding any team. Skills read this to decide ordering and emphasis; they never skip a capability the user explicitly asks for.

ic.label: Individual Contributor
ic.pm_emphasis: personal work: assigned issues, PRs awaiting my review, my stale branches
ic.metrics: skip team scorecards unless asked; surface only my cycle-time outliers
ic.monitoring_emphasis: Sentry errors touching repos I maintain; skip team-wide alerting unless asked

manager.label: Engineering Manager
manager.pm_emphasis: team-level: sprint health, stale in-progress, unassigned work, WIP limits, aging PRs
manager.support_emphasis: unanswered support across all team channels + SLA risk
manager.metrics: lead with Compass team scorecards (delegate to compass-analyst), flag gate regressions
manager.monitoring_emphasis: team-wide alerting + SLA/error-budget risk: firing Datadog monitors, spiking Sentry issues, failing cron monitors

staff.label: Staff / Principal Engineer
staff.pm_emphasis: cross-cutting: PRs/issues spanning multiple repos, tech-debt and architecture follow-ups
staff.support_emphasis: deep/technical unanswered threads where codebase grounding matters most
staff.metrics: Compass trends across the repos I touch; correlate with PR throughput
staff.monitoring_emphasis: cross-service error/perf trends and systemic reliability risks; correlate Sentry/Datadog with recent releases
